description: What Tendeck plugs into: live connectors, the next ones being built, and what is planned, each with what it gives the agent and how to connect. Use it when they ask 'does Tendeck work with X?' or name a tool they use (dotloop, SkySlope, Zillow, kvCORE, Canva...). If X is not live, tell them honestly, give the 'today' workaround, and record their interest with connector_request.
name: connectors_catalog
